2. Real physics step / 真实物理计算

The joint sliders command motor angles. The solver calculates where the robot actually moves; the picture follows that calculated state.

During the independent four-second native-engine run, the study recorded 36 peak contact points and 135.80 N mm peak actuator torque. The largest joint-limit excess was 0.00 degrees.

3. What needs fixing or proving / 仍需解决和验证

Standing test: FAIL / 站立测试未通过
The open-loop motor-angle hold fell during the four-second test. The lowest body reference height was 36.60 mm. Balance-controller behavior has not been established by this test.
固定电机目标角度、未运行平衡控制时，机器人在测试中倒下。此结果不能证明平衡软件运行时的表现。
Question / 问题Current result / 当前结果
Can the complete robot be articulated?Yes: 14 named motor joints, sourced axes and limits.
Will the printed legs and mounts hold the loads?CANNOT DETERMINE — deformation and strength were not solved.
Does every screw or bearing fit?CANNOT DETERMINE — collision meshes use convex hulls and do not prove hole or fastener fit.
Are cables safe throughout movement?CANNOT DETERMINE — flexible cable dynamics are outside this study.
Which servos are modeled?ROBOTIS XL330-M288-T in the published assembly. No cheaper-servo substitution has been made in this study.

4. How this was checked / 检查方法

  • Whole robot draws 70 components; official WASM advances real 2 ms dynamics step
  • Gravity/contact study returns contacts, finite joint coordinates and nonzero actuator force
  • Impossible servo command clamps at sourced joint limit
  • Unknown joint negative control refuses
  • Deliberately mismatched asset SHA-256 refuses before model compilation

All 288960 published triangles were transformed into the moving body frames. Maximum round-trip coordinate error, including the written STL precision: 3.72e-06 mm. The 14 joint origins and axes were cross-checked against the existing measured joint records.

MuJoCo 3.12.0 computed 2000 native physics steps in 0.40 CPU seconds. The browser and native engine can produce small numerical/contact differences; these are separately recorded.

Collision meshes are convex hulls. Adjacent parent-child contacts are filtered. Upstream inertia, friction and actuator fits remain assumptions for this build.
